description: A status file the newest run disagrees with is stale, and the panel draws `unknown` rather than the value in it. NARROWED BY ADR-0070: a stale reading is still a DIRECTION. The old rule here was `a stale destroyed must not grey the map, and a stale up must not colour it`, on the grounds that the map is not entitled to a firmer answer than the panel gives - and it rested on grey meaning `destroyed`. It does not: this page's own CSS says `absent` and `gone` look alike because what a reader needs from both is the same, DO NOT READ THIS AS LIVE. That is weaker than the panel's `unknown`, not firmer. Lit is the firmer answer, in the other direction, and it was the one being drawn. So a stale `destroyed` returns `destroyed-unverified` and greys the map, because the environment is not up YET; a stale `up` still returns `unknown` and stays lit, because it is not gone YET. Same argument, both directions. Nothing else moves: no state, no reading at all, and an environment nothing has reported on are all still `unknown`.

expect.note: last seen destroyed in AWS; a cycle is under way and has not reported
